items.q: So Willie asked me would I go to London.

ctx.x: come back, because I'm going to rehearse the choir for an hour." I said, "Just stay here and I'll be back." It was right around the corner. It wasn't over here, it was on Marshall Street, it was over on the East side. So Lenny say, "Hot dog, what you know? I'm going to call Willie and tell Willie we have found Sippie." They had been looking for me and looking for me. So they called long distance. He said, "Sippie, can I use your telephone?" I said, "Yeah." So he used my -- on a Sunday night -- so he used my…

So Willie asked me would I go to London. So I say, "I don't know, I might," like that. But I wasn't much about going, because I asked Victoria if she going and she said, "London, I went." Because Vicki said she wasn't going, well, I wasn't so going by myself, you know, and had never been over there, you know.
